text:
The year is 1873, an age of exploration, caravans and dangerous frontiers. For decades the western kingdoms
have suffered drought, failed harvests and political unrest. Rumors have spread of a distant land beyond the endless
desert known as The Golden Dunes. Travelers whisper that beyond the dunes stands a hidden city of knowledge, relics
and new beginnings. Now thousands gather with wagons and caravans, risking everything to reach the Golden City.
An explorer recently returned from the eastern deserts carrying a strange golden relic. Before he could explain
its origin, he disappeared mysteriously.The only clue left behind was a map pointing toward the Golden Dunes.
------------------------------------------------------------------

People Are Migrating as the old provinces of the west collapses.
Trade routes have failed, rivers have dried and famine grips many towns. Explorers returning from the east speak of
fertile lands, and beyond the desert and a legendary settlement called Aurion, the Golden City. Those who reach it
are promised land, opportunity, and a new life. But between here and there lies 500 miles of deadly desert.
------------------------------------------------------------------
Before beginning the journey, every traveler must decide their path.

Each role carries its own advantages during the journey.
Your choice will influence how you survive the Golden Dunes.
------------------------------------------------------------------

Men of the frontier often took roles of strength and leadership.
Male travelers often worked in physically demanding trades or dangerous expeditions.

Women of the frontier carried knowledge that kept caravans alive.
Female travelers commonly mastered healing, education and trade skills essential for survival.
------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------
The Food Market
--------------
At the edge of the frontier lies the Far East Market, famous for feeding entire caravans. Merchants shout their prices
as travelers rush to buy supplies. Many journeys have failed because a caravan underestimated its food.
Stock wisely, the Golden Dunes are unforgiving.
------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------
Clothing Store
--------------
Across the street stands The Silk Caravan Outfitters, known for garments built to survive harsh climates. Proper clothing
shields travelers from sandstorms and freezing desert nights. Without it, even the strongest adventurer may fall.
------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------
Weapons Store
--------------
Further down the road stands Iron Fang Armory, a shop filled with weapons of legendary reputation. The blacksmith proudly
claims that one of his blades once slew a desert warlord. Weapons are not only for hunting - bandits and desert beasts
roam the dunes. A poorly armed caravan rarely reaches its destination.
------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------
Animal Market
--------------
At the far end of the settlement lies the Beast Caravan Grounds. Caravans choose between famous animals built for long
journeys. Some whisper of rare mythical creatures trained by distant tribes. The animal you choose will pull your wagon
and carry your hopes across the desert. Choose wisely - your beast will walk every mile beside you.
------------------------------------------------------------------
